about_the_game:
FORGET REFLEXES. MASTER YOUR MIND.

Survival of the Smartest.

Every Step Counts is a deep, turn-based-tactics puzzle role-play adventure game where your brain is your greatest weapon. You command a mystical serpent by building mathematical equations. It's a game of calculated risks and strategic planning.

To survive, you must navigate a treacherous, narrative-driven world where every attack, every choice, and every single step is a decision for the survival. Your calculator is your weapon, your tool, and your savior. How will you build the equation for your victory?

THE FULL ADVENTURE: WHAT TO EXPECT

(Note to Players: The free demo of the game showcases the core arcade mode. The full game expands these mechanics into a role-play adventure!)

  • Explore a dungeon and the world of interconnected islands.

  • The grid is filled with unique enemies! Use your calculator to outmaneuver foes, building equations to strike them with your poison and master the ultimate puzzle.

  • COMMUNITY-DRIVEN DEVELOPMENT - The adventure will be shaped by your feedback! The full game will be expanded and refined based on the ideas and suggestions from you, the player.

    YOUR MIND IS THE BATTLEFIELD. THE EQUATION IS YOUR WEAPON, WISHLIST NOW!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer / SteamOS
  • Processor: Dual Core CPU @ 2.0GHz+
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 / Vulkan compatible graphics card with up-to-date drivers (Mesa for AMD/Intel, NVIDIA proprietary)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Requires Steam Client running for Leaderboard functionality. Performance may vary depending on distribution and driver versions.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Modern Linux Distribution / SteamOS (Latest)
  • Processor: Quad Core CPU @ 2.5GHz+
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with robust Vulkan support (AMD GCN+, NVIDIA Kepler+)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: Requires Steam Client running for Leaderboard functionality. Performance may vary depending on distribution and driver versions.
